1.2.21（1002021）· 键盘输入、投屏鼠标与屏幕方向
column2: 1.2.21 (1002021) - Keyboard input, projected mouse and screen orientation

column1: 新增独立键盘悬浮按钮，手机和平板不用展开“控”即可打开或收起软键盘，支持拖动调整位置。
column2: Added a draggable floating keyboard button for phones and tablets to open or hide the soft keyboard without expanding Controls.

column1: 新增连续输入：打开软键盘后，点击远端其他输入框仍保持键盘开启，输入直接传给远端；用户主动收起后结束。保留全屏三指上滑，实体键盘和完整组合键不自动弹出软键盘。
column2: Added continuous input: tapping another remote field keeps the soft keyboard open and sends typing directly to the remote device until you hide it. The full-screen three-finger swipe remains available; physical keys and preset shortcuts do not open the soft keyboard automatically.

column1: 优化应用单独投屏的实体鼠标接收通路、电视与本屏坐标换算及跨通路去重，避免兼容触摸事件提前松键后补发重复点击；有线投屏效果仍需真机验证。
column2: Improved physical mouse input reception for independent projection, coordinate conversion between TV and local display, and cross-path deduplication. Prevents duplicate clicks after early release of mouse-compatible touch events. Wired projection still requires device validation.

column1: 补充投屏鼠标各接收层、目标显示设备、输入焦点与画面尺寸的诊断日志，不记录输入文字或密码。
column2: Added diagnostics for projected mouse reception layers, target display, input focus and surface size. Typed text and passwords are not recorded.

column1: 修复应用忽略系统旋转锁定的问题，手机和平板默认跟随系统旋转设置，不再强制自动切换横竖屏。
column2: Fixed the app ignoring the system rotation lock. Phones and tablets now follow system rotation settings by default instead of forcing automatic rotation.

column1: “控”中的屏幕方向按钮改为选择菜单，支持跟随系统、固定竖屏和固定横屏；手动选择仅对本次远控生效。
column2: The orientation button under Controls now opens a selector for Follow system, Lock portrait and Lock landscape. Manual choices apply only to the current remote session.

column1: 单独投屏使用独立方向策略：默认适配横向外接屏，也可手动固定方向；返回手机或平板后恢复本屏选择，不改变远端分辨率。
column2: Independent projection has its own orientation policy: landscape external screens are fitted automatically, or orientation can be locked manually. Returning to the phone or tablet restores its own choice without changing remote resolution.

column1: 更新手势说明和多语言文字，补充方向选择与窗口应用的诊断日志；取消菜单或切换显示设备时不误修改另一块屏幕的方向。
column2: Updated gesture help and translations, and added diagnostics for orientation choices and window changes. Dismissing the menu or switching displays does not accidentally change the other screen's orientation.

适合控制电脑：
• 单指滑动：移动鼠标
• 单击：左键
• 轻点一次，第二次按住并移动：拖拽，松手结束
• 长按或双指轻点：右键
• 双指平行滑动：滚动
• 双指捏合：缩放画面
• 虚拟鼠标：左右键、中键和滚轮与实体鼠标一致，按住鼠标拖动区即可移动远端指针
• 虚拟鼠标开启且画面放大后：单指拖动画面其他区域直接平移视野
• 边缘跟随开启后：手机/平板放大画面，手指移动鼠标到可视区域中心附近，视野立即跟随；停手即停，抬手再滑无需等待
• 虚拟鼠标拖动区同样支持中心跟随；到达远端桌面边界后，鼠标继续移动
• 实体鼠标：靠近画面边缘并短暂停留后自动平移，越靠边越快
• 全屏三指上滑：调出系统键盘，输入直达远端
column2:
For computers:
• One-finger swipe: move cursor
• Tap: left click
• Tap, then hold the second tap and move: drag; release to finish
• Long press or two-finger tap: right click
• Two parallel fingers: scroll
• Pinch: zoom
• Virtual mouse: left/right/middle buttons and wheel; hold its drag area to move the cursor
• With virtual mouse enabled and zoomed: drag elsewhere to pan
• With tracking enabled: move the cursor near the view center to pan immediately; stop to pause; subsequent swipes need no waiting
• Virtual mouse dragging also supports center tracking
• Physical mouse: hover briefly near an edge to pan; closer means faster
• Three-finger swipe up in full screen: open local keyboard and type remotely

1.2.19（1002019）· 实体鼠标、画面跟随与大字体适配
column2: 1.2.19 (1002019) · Physical mouse, tracking and large fonts

column1: 修复远端光标图层可能遮挡实体鼠标点击的问题；优化鼠标与触摸兼容事件的识别及点击去重，避免左右键被误拦截。
column2: Fixed cursor overlays blocking physical mouse clicks; improved mouse/touch classification and click deduplication.

column1: 修复输入 Windows 登录密码后，本地键盘已收起但放大画面的鼠标跟随仍被阻止的问题；按实际键盘可见性和编辑状态恢复跟随，保留缩放比例与画面位置。
column2: Restores zoomed-view tracking after the Windows login keyboard closes, using actual visibility and editing state while preserving zoom and position.

column1: 优化系统大字体下的按钮适配：常用按钮、键控快捷栏和底部导航随字体调整尺寸，已保存连接工具区支持换行，减少文字被截断。
column2: Buttons, floating controls and navigation adapt to larger system fonts. Saved-connection tools wrap to reduce clipping.

column1: 补充键盘显示、焦点与画面跟随阻止原因的脱敏诊断，不记录输入内容；有线应用单独投屏的实体鼠标兼容问题仍待实机排查与验证。
column2: Added sanitized keyboard visibility, focus and tracking diagnostics without input content. Wired app-only projection mouse compatibility still needs device investigation.

column1: 1.2.18（1002018）· 投屏鼠标与软键盘组合键
修复应用单独投屏时，实体鼠标连续移动事件可能被误过滤的问题；按事件类型和坐标精准去重，保留点击、拖动及触控原有路径。
column2: Improved filtering of continuous physical mouse movement during app-only projection, preserving clicks, dragging and touch paths.

column1: 优化投屏窗口的远端指针显示与位置更新，切换显示设备时清理旧输入状态；补充鼠标移动、过滤原因及指针状态诊断，便于排查设备差异。
column2: Improved projected cursor updates and reset old input state on display changes; added movement, filtering and cursor diagnostics.

column1: 修复选中 Ctrl 后使用软键盘输入 Q 等字母时，远端可能多出 Shift 的问题；区分字母字符与功能键编码，保留明确选中的 Shift、普通文字及中文输入。
column2: Fixed extra Shift when typing letters such as Q with Ctrl selected. Preserves explicit Shift, regular text and Chinese input.

column1: 投屏输入日志仅在诊断开关开启时记录，并限制输出频率；具体有线投屏兼容性仍需结合设备实测。
column2: Projection input logs are diagnostic-only and rate-limited. Wired projection compatibility still requires device tests.

column1: “键 → 更多”新增 ←、↑、↓、→ 四个方向按钮，支持配合选中的 Ctrl、Shift 等修饰键操作；点击不主动弹出软键盘，长按可调整顺序。
column2: Added arrow buttons under Keys > More, with modifiers and reordering, without opening the soft keyboard.

column1: 修复打开本地键盘后，外接键盘或 PC 键盘的方向键、翻页键未正确传递到远端的问题；补齐 PageUp、PageDown、Home、End 和 Insert 映射。
column2: Fixed external/PC navigation keys with the local keyboard open; completed PageUp, PageDown, Home, End and Insert mapping.

column1: 优化实体方向键长按连续输入、重复事件去重及失去焦点后的松键处理，避免重复发送和卡键；中文组字时保留本地输入法选词。
column2: Improved arrow-key repeats, deduplication and key release on focus loss; preserves local IME candidate selection.

column1: 补充方向键与输入法状态的脱敏诊断记录，不记录输入文字或候选内容；保留原有自定义按键排序。
column2: Added sanitized navigation/IME diagnostics without text or candidates; custom ordering retained.

column1: 连接失败错误码改为中文提示，区分 ID 服务器密钥不匹配、服务器密钥无效、连接超时及中继失败等情况。
column2: Added Chinese connection errors distinguishing ID server key mismatch, invalid keys, timeouts and relay failures.

column1: 远端密码错误、权限拒绝与连接中断等常见提示同步中文化；保留自动重连和用户确认后降级连接的原有判断。
column2: Localized common password, permission and disconnection errors while preserving reconnect and user-approved security fallback logic.
1.2.15 (1002015) · Connection stability and PC full screen

column1: 自建 ID 服务器未配置 API 账号时，连接前跳过不必要的账号会话准备；已记住账号或配置 API 时仍按原流程处理。
column2: Skips unnecessary account preparation for custom servers without API accounts; remembered/configured accounts keep their normal flow.

column1: 在线状态查询只连接 ID 服务器的辅助 TCP 端口，不再探测相邻 WebSocket 端口，减少对远控建链的干扰。
column2: Availability checks use only the auxiliary ID-server TCP port, avoiding adjacent WebSocket probes and connection interference.

column1: WebSocket 连接失败后的重试限定次数并共用超时期限，避免异常服务器导致反复尝试。
column2: WebSocket retries are bounded and share a timeout deadline.

column1: 修复鸿蒙 PC 远控全屏：进入沉浸式全屏后，右侧功能栏收为右上角悬浮“控”按钮，保留独立的“退出全屏”按钮；退出后恢复固定侧栏。
column2: Fixed immersive PC full screen: controls float at top right with a separate Exit full screen button; fixed sidebar returns on exit.

column1: 放大远端画面后，虚拟鼠标拖到右侧或下侧边缘时，继续拖动可让画面移开并露出黑色操作空间；控件和自带箭头保持贴合。
column2: In a zoomed view, dragging beyond right/bottom edges exposes black operating space while keeping the virtual mouse and arrow aligned.

column1: 修复在画面其他区域平移后，虚拟鼠标控件与自带箭头可能分离的问题；反向拖动可收回边缘空白。
column2: Fixed virtual mouse/arrow separation after panning elsewhere; reverse dragging removes edge space.

column1: 开启虚拟鼠标时，控件外的单指拖动只用于移动画面，不再误移动远端光标；未放大时不再把该手势当作触控板输入。
column2: Outside the virtual mouse, one-finger dragging pans only and no longer moves the remote cursor or acts as a trackpad when unzoomed.

column1: 新增按设备配置断开后锁定远端、隐私屏幕和自动解锁远端系统；功能是否生效取决于被控端支持与授权。
column2: Added per-device lock-on-disconnect, privacy screen and automatic system unlock, subject to remote support and permission.

column1: 自动解锁仅在符合条件的加密连接中发送本机安全保存的系统密码；密码不参与连接备份或云同步。
column2: Automatic unlock sends securely stored system passwords only on eligible encrypted connections; excluded from backups and cloud sync.

column1: 补充远端安全操作的脱敏诊断日志，记录请求、回执与跳过原因，不记录密码或验证码。
column2: Added sanitized security request, response and skip diagnostics without passwords or verification codes.

column1: 关闭在线状态查询后，已保存设备图标不再显示状态圆点和状态图例；开启后恢复显示。
column2: Status dots and legends hide when availability checks are off and return when enabled.

column1: 改进个人云空间同步的完成确认、错误提示及云目录快照写入兼容性；真实跨设备恢复仍需在云服务上验证。
column2: Improved cloud sync confirmation, errors and snapshot writing compatibility; cross-device restoration still needs real cloud testing.

column1: 设置中的“查询服务器/设备在线状态”默认关闭；关闭时首页不再定时向服务器查询已保存设备的在线状态。
column2: Availability checks default to off, disabling periodic saved-device server queries.

column1: 需要在线状态提示时可手动开启；此开关不影响输入 ID 后连接远端。
column2: Enable availability hints if needed; manual ID connections are unaffected.

column1: 修复全屏按钮文字与选中状态未及时更新的问题；切换中防止重复点击，失败时恢复状态并提示，退出远控时恢复系统栏。
column2: Fixed full-screen labels and selection state; blocks repeated switching, restores state on failure and system bars on exit.

column1: 全屏与普通模式复用视频显示组件，仅系统栏或黑边区域变化时不再重复重建解码器；保留实际旋转、换屏和显示目标变化时的安全重绑定，减少切换黑屏。
column2: Reuses the video surface across full-screen changes without unnecessary decoder rebuilds, while retaining safe rebinding for rotation and display changes.

column1: 优化手机和平板放大后的鼠标画面跟随：开启边缘跟随后，手指将鼠标移到可视区域中心附近即可连续平移视野，停手即停，再次滑动无需等待；虚拟鼠标拖动区同步支持。
column2: Improved zoomed phone/tablet tracking: moving near the view center pans immediately, stopping pauses, and repeated swipes need no waiting; virtual mouse dragging also supported.

column1: 补充全屏切换、系统窗口调用、画面复用与恢复的阶段、耗时和失败码日志，方便排查设备兼容问题。
column2: Added phase, timing and error diagnostics for full screen, window calls and video reuse/recovery.

column1: 诊断模式新增系统崩溃、卡死及系统终止事件的本地脱敏采集，可随诊断日志导出；是否获得完整调用栈取决于系统投递，诊断默认关闭，不自动上传。
column2: Diagnostics can collect sanitized system crash, hang and termination records locally. Stack availability depends on system delivery; off by default, never uploaded automatically.

column1: 增强已保存设备在线查询的分阶段诊断与 Wi-Fi、蜂窝网络类型关联，辅助定位家庭 Wi-Fi 下保存连接或查询时的异常；这项增强不代表已确认修复相关闪退原因。
column2: Added availability-check phase and Wi-Fi/cellular diagnostics to investigate home-network crashes; not a confirmed crash fix.

column1: 1.2.0（1002006）· 控制端功能与诊断修订
新增独立文件传输会话、批量和文件夹上传，以及远端新建文件夹、重命名和删除；文件夹上传暂不保留空文件夹。
column2: Added file-only sessions, batch/folder uploads and remote create/rename/delete. Empty upload folders are not preserved.

column1: 新增地址簿手动双向同步预览、冲突处理和设备标签管理，不同步本地连接密码与密钥。
column2: Added manual two-way address book sync preview, conflict handling and tags, excluding passwords and keys.

column1: 支持扫描和显示服务器配置二维码，扫码后确认保存才生效。
column2: Added server configuration QR scanning/display; scanned settings apply after confirmation.

column1: 新增远端画面录像、录像导出和删除；录像为 WebM，仅包含画面，不包含声音。
column2: Added remote WebM video recording, export and deletion, without audio.

column1: 完善前台会话网络中断后的限次重连、Wayland 文本输入授权提示及已接通语音的后台任务处理。
column2: Improved bounded reconnects, Wayland text permission prompts and background handling for connected voice calls.

column1: 优化单独投屏方向策略；实际可用性仍受设备与接收端能力限制。
column2: Improved app-only projection orientation; availability depends on device and receiver capabilities.

column1: 完善文件传输、地址簿同步、录像、扫码、重连和语音诊断，记录操作阶段、耗时和错误码；日志默认关闭，敏感内容不写入新增日志。
column2: Expanded transfer, sync, recording, QR, reconnect and voice diagnostics with phases, timing and error codes; off by default and excludes sensitive content.

column1: 完善官方服务器账号认证与网页登录流程，优化登录恢复、连接等待、取消和异常提示；补充脱敏诊断日志。
column2: Improved official account/web login, session restore, connection waiting, cancellation and sanitized diagnostics.

column1: 修复服务器账号与地址簿弹窗请求结束后按钮仍不可点击的问题，优化设置入口的文字层级及深浅色可读性。
column2: Fixed disabled account dialog buttons after requests and improved light/dark text readability.

column1: 单指移动画面按显示帧合并更新；光标图片未变化时不再重复复制，减少界面处理开销。
column2: Coalesces one-finger panning per display frame and avoids copying unchanged cursor images.

column1: 优化 VP9 软解码入队与渲染的锁分离，减少视频提交对输入发送的间接阻塞。
column2: Separated VP9 software decode queue and rendering locks to reduce input blocking.

column1: 更新应用单层图标为 1024×1024 方角不透明图片，修正透明边角并校验打包后的图标。
column2: Updated single-layer icon to opaque square 1024×1024 and verified the packaged icon.

column1: 整合本轮密码显示保护：已保存密码不再回显，支持更换、取消与保存后清除；新输入密码仍可临时查看。
column2: Saved passwords no longer display; supports changing, cancelling and clearing on save. Newly typed passwords can be viewed temporarily.

column1: 保留连接认证脱敏诊断、PC 自适应布局与 One-KVM 键鼠兼容改进；升级后首次启动展示更新说明。
column2: Retains sanitized authentication diagnostics, adaptive PC layout and One-KVM improvements; shows changes on first launch after upgrading.

column1: 1.2.0（1002004）· 密码保护、PC 布局与键鼠兼容
column2: 1.2.0 (1002004) · Password protection, PC layout and input compatibility

column1: 已保存连接的密码仅显示“密码已保存”，不再回填或明文查看；新输入密码仍可临时查看，保存后立即隐藏。
column2: Saved passwords show a status only, never plaintext or autofill. Newly typed passwords hide immediately after saving.

column1: 支持更换、取消更换和清除密码，清除在保存后生效；修改名称或分组保留原密码，更换远端 ID 不再沿用旧设备密码。
column2: Password changes/cancellation/clearing are supported. Names/groups retain passwords; changing remote ID does not reuse the old device password.

column1: 增强连接认证诊断：细分服务器拒绝原因，记录令牌是否携带及配置匹配状态；不记录密码、令牌或服务器敏感原文，不改变认证和加密策略。
column2: Added sanitized authentication rejection/token-presence/configuration diagnostics without credentials or changes to encryption policy.

column1: 优化鸿蒙 PC 连接首页：顶部快捷连接、下方自适应双列/三列设备列表，详细选项在右侧展开，窄窗口恢复单列。
column2: Improved PC home: quick connection above adaptive two/three-column device lists, right-side details and single-column narrow layout.

column1: 新增按设备保存的自动、1:1 映射和传统键盘模式，识别 One-KVM 后优先使用传统模式，避免扫描码解释不一致导致串键。
column2: Added per-device automatic, 1:1 and legacy keyboard modes; One-KVM prefers legacy to avoid scan-code mismatches.

column1: 新增相对鼠标协议，支持触屏、虚拟鼠标和实体鼠标的移动增量；模式切换先释放按键，出入画面及切屏时重置取样，减少跳位。
column2: Added relative mouse deltas for touch, virtual and physical mice; releases buttons and resets samples on mode/display changes.

column1: 新增远端光标来源选项，识别 One-KVM 的画面内嵌光标，避免双光标叠加；普通远端保留真实光标反馈。
column2: Added remote cursor source selection to avoid duplicate One-KVM embedded cursors while retaining normal remote feedback.

column1: 新增“高清优先”和“自定义”画质模式，支持码率比例 10%～2000% 与目标帧率 5～120 FPS，参数可随连接保存、备份与同步。
column2: Added Best quality and Custom modes with 10–2000% bitrate and 5–120 FPS, saved/backed up/synced with connections.

column1: 画质入口位于新建或编辑连接的“更多选项 → 连接模式”，保存后下次连接生效；码率百分比不代表固定 Mbps。
column2: Quality is under More options > Connection mode; applies next connection. Percentages are not fixed Mbps.

column1: 公共中继下自定义码率超过 100% 时回退至 50%，目标帧率最高 30 FPS；自建服务器或直连可使用更高设置，保留原有默认模式。
column2: Public relays cap settings above 100% at 50% and 30 FPS; custom/direct connections allow more. Existing defaults retained.

column1: 后台保持低帧率，返回前台恢复所选画质；登录、画质重发和解码回退时保留自定义参数。
column2: Background uses low FPS and restores quality in foreground; custom parameters survive login/resend/decoder fallback.

column1: 恢复聊天面板中的“发起语音”入口及通话状态提示，支持取消呼叫、静音和挂断。
column2: Restored voice call entry and status, with cancellation, mute and hang-up.

column1: 语音仅在获得麦克风授权且远端接听后开始采集，进入后台或断开连接时结束通话。
column2: Voice capture begins only after microphone permission and remote answer; ends on background/disconnect in this version.

column1: 保留文字聊天、账号地址簿及上一版本的界面优化；语音通话需远端客户端支持。
column2: Retained chat, accounts/address books and UI improvements. Voice requires remote client support.

column1: 1.2.0（1002002）· 账号地址簿与操作体验
新增官方 RustDesk Server Pro 与第三方 rustdesk-api 账号登录入口，支持记住登录、退出及邮箱或身份验证器二次验证。
column2: Added official Server Pro and third-party rustdesk-api login, remembered sessions, logout and email/authenticator verification.

column1: 支持读取个人、共享及旧版地址簿，勾选设备导入已保存连接；已有设备自动跳过，不覆盖名称、密码和分组。
column2: Reads personal/shared/legacy address books for selected import; skips existing devices without overwriting names, passwords or groups.

column1: 新增可选的自建 ID 服务器账号权限认证；登录令牌仅保存在本机安全存储，不进入连接备份或云同步。
column2: Added optional custom ID-server account authentication; tokens are securely local only, excluded from backups/cloud sync.

column1: 新增与远端的文字聊天，支持发送、接收和未读提示；聊天记录仅保留本次连接。
column2: Added remote text chat with unread hints and session-only history.

column1: 优化平板横屏首页：上方快速连接，下方集中显示已保存设备，详细编辑选项使用侧边面板。
column2: Improved landscape tablet home with quick connection above saved devices and side-panel editing.

column1: 横屏远控默认展开两侧快捷栏；弹出键盘时保持当前画面比例并上移避让，不再整体缩小。
column2: Landscape opens both control bars by default; keyboard moves the view upward without shrinking it.

column1: 连接信息默认关闭，按需展开并支持拖动；优化拖动边界和点击判定。
column2: Connection info defaults closed, expands on demand and supports dragging with improved bounds/click detection.

column1: 保存连接后新增“已保存”提示，自动向上淡出；常用按钮统一圆角矩形风格，可在设置中切换。
column2: Added upward-fading Saved tip and optional rounded-rectangle button style.

column1: 优化“键 / 控”按钮排序：排序列表改为长按后上下拖动，替代上移、下移按钮，松手自动保存，并支持恢复默认顺序。
column2: Reordering uses hold-and-drag instead of up/down buttons; saves on release and supports reset.

column1: “键 → 更多”中的按键和组合键新增独立排序；长按任意按键进入排序列表，重新打开或重启应用后保留顺序，不影响主快捷栏。
column2: Extra keys/shortcuts have independent persistent ordering, opened by long press without affecting main controls.

column1: 手机和平板新增可开关的虚拟鼠标，支持左右键点击、按住拖动、滚轮滚动和中键操作，并记住开关状态。
column2: Added persistent phone/tablet virtual mouse with left/right buttons, dragging, wheel and middle button.

column1: 虚拟鼠标采用透明蓝灰玻璃外观、细描边和淡蓝色按下反馈，清晰区分左右键、滚轮与移动区域。
column2: Virtual mouse uses transparent blue-gray glass, fine borders and pale-blue pressed feedback with distinct operating areas.

column1: 修复虚拟鼠标与远端光标漂移、缩放和平移后位置不同步的问题，改善多屏切换后的光标对齐。
column2: Fixed virtual/remote cursor drift and alignment after zoom, pan and display switching.

column1: 修复关闭虚拟鼠标后按钮仍显示选中，以及左右键、滚轮点击无效或重复触发的问题。
column2: Fixed stale virtual-mouse selection and invalid/duplicate button and wheel actions.

column1: 开启虚拟鼠标并放大画面后，可拖动鼠标移动远端光标，单指拖动画面其他区域平移视野。
column2: With virtual mouse and zoom, drag the mouse for pointer movement and other areas to pan.

column1: 手机和平板横屏时，“键”默认位于左上角、“控”位于右上角，展开方向改为向下；两组悬浮栏支持在屏幕内自由拖动。
column2: Landscape defaults Keys top left and Controls top right, both expanding down and draggable anywhere.

column1: 长按“键 / 控”栏中的具体按钮可自定义排列顺序并保存；优化横屏软键盘弹出后的画面避让。
column2: Hold buttons to customize persistent ordering; improved landscape keyboard avoidance.

column1: 1.2.0（1002000）· 云同步、连接协议与界面体验
新增华为个人云空间同步，可在同一华为账号的设备间同步已保存连接、分组和服务器配置。
column2: Added HUAWEI Cloud sync for saved connections, groups and server configuration across devices sharing an account.

column1: 密码与服务器密钥默认不上传；用户可选择使用 AES-256-GCM 加密后同步敏感信息，并支持手动同步和云端恢复。
column2: Passwords and keys excluded by default; optional AES-256-GCM encrypted sync, manual sync and restore supported.

column1: 完善官方服务器与自建服务器连接流程，补充 IPv4/IPv6、TCP、中继、UDP/KCP 与 WebRTC 连接能力及诊断信息。
column2: Expanded official/custom connection flows with IPv4/IPv6, TCP, relay, UDP/KCP and WebRTC support and diagnostics.

column1: 优化连接建立、打洞和中继回退速度，修复候选地址选择、连接重试及快速重连中的多项稳定性问题。
column2: Improved setup, hole punching and relay fallback; fixed candidate selection and retry/reconnect stability.

column1: 修复多屏远控时屏幕画面与远端光标状态可能串屏、跳动或显示不一致的问题。
column2: Fixed multi-display video/cursor state mixing, jumps and inconsistencies.

column1: 自建服务器配置保存后立即生效，支持配置导入与导出；连接密码弹窗可直接输入，并可选择是否保存。
column2: Custom server settings apply immediately with import/export; password dialogs accept input and optional saving.

column1: 优化长按拖动判定，降低鼠标左键长按和触摸操作的误触发。
column2: Improved hold/drag classification to reduce accidental actions.

column1: 更新连接页紧凑布局、排序操作和连接信息面板；首页展开折叠及“连接 / 设置”切换增加平滑过渡动画。
column2: Added compact connection layout, sorting/info improvements and smooth expansion/tab animations.

column1: 1.1.0（1001007）· 界面、文件排序与连接恢复
column2: 1.1.0 (1001007) · UI, file sorting and connection recovery

column1: 连接页与设置页统一柔和卡片、悬浮导航和淡蓝色选中风格，同时适配深色模式。
column2: Unified soft cards, floating navigation and pale-blue selection with dark-mode support.

column1: 远控上方默认显示折叠的“键”快捷栏；上下“键 / 控”统一收放样式、尺寸与伸缩过渡，降低展开面板的遮挡。
column2: Keys defaults collapsed; Keys/Controls share sizing and expansion transitions with less obstruction.

column1: 修复 Ctrl、Alt、Shift、Win/Cmd 选中状态显示不及时；折叠后保留按键状态，并以小蓝点提示仍有修饰键选中。
column2: Fixed modifier selection updates; collapsed controls preserve state and show a blue active-modifier dot.

column1: 快捷栏新增“释放”按钮，一次取消所有已选修饰键，不折叠面板、不打开或关闭本地键盘；补充手势和组合键说明。
column2: Added Release to clear modifiers without collapsing or changing keyboard visibility; expanded help.

column1: 底部鼠标/触摸模式按钮改为居中的纯文字，统一与相邻功能按钮的视觉风格。
column2: Mouse/touch button uses centered text matching adjacent controls.

column1: 远端文件浏览新增名称、类型、大小、修改时间排序及升降序切换，文件夹优先，名称支持数字自然排序，切换排序保留已选文件。
column2: Added remote file sorting by name/type/size/date and direction, folders first, natural numeric names and preserved selection.

column1: 优化取回文件界面，长文件名最多显示三行，详细信息两行，增加项目数量和空目录提示。
column2: Improved download browser with three-line names, two-line details, counts and empty-folder hints.

column1: 修复直连安全握手失败后连接路线丢失，导致未触发加密中继重试的问题；不自动降级为未加密连接。
column2: Preserves failed direct routes so encrypted relay retries trigger correctly; no automatic unencrypted fallback.

column1: 完善后台任务错误码兼容和失败回退判断，补充连接路线、登录失败原因及后台任务诊断信息。
column2: Improved background task error compatibility/fallback with route, login and task diagnostics.

column1: 1.1.0（1001006）· 键盘、快捷栏与连接界面优化
手机远控功能栏改为半透明悬浮胶囊，支持拖动、收起和展开；平板及 PC 侧栏同步优化外观。
column2: Phone controls use translucent draggable/collapsible capsules; tablet and PC sidebars updated.

column1: 屏幕切换、鼠标模式、移动画面及边缘跟随统一使用淡蓝色选中态，并适配深色模式。
column2: Displays, input mode, panning and auto-pan share pale-blue selection with dark-mode support.

column1: 修复手机底部功能按钮显示不全，调整工具栏高度、间距及常用按钮宽度。
column2: Fixed clipped phone controls by adjusting bar height, spacing and widths.

column1: 修复多屏切换后旧光标坐标反复隐藏鼠标的问题，改善 PC 屏幕 1、2 光标偶发消失，并补充诊断记录。
column2: Fixed stale multi-display cursor coordinates hiding the cursor, improving PC displays 1/2 with diagnostics.

column1: 远控键盘快捷栏支持拖动，可收起为半透明小按钮，点击小按钮即可重新展开。
column2: Keyboard controls are draggable and collapse to a translucent button.

column1: 优化已保存连接的搜索布局，搜索框从按钮左侧展开，搜索、备份和分组按钮不再位移。
column2: Search expands left without shifting Search, Backup or Group buttons.

column1: 快捷栏发送 Ctrl+Shift+Esc、Ctrl+Shift+Del、Alt+F4 或 Ctrl+Alt+Del 后不再自动弹出本地软键盘。
column2: Full shortcut buttons no longer automatically open the local keyboard.

column1: 补齐 F1–F12 物理功能键传递，修复控制 macOS 时 F3 无法送达远端的问题。
column2: Completed physical F1–F12 forwarding, including macOS F3.

column1: 左右 Ctrl、Shift、Alt/Option 与 Meta/Command 按键分别按 RustDesk 官方协议传递，改善 Ctrl+↑ 等多键组合。
column2: Forwards left/right modifiers separately using official protocol, improving combinations such as Ctrl+Up.

column1: 组合键不再把当前修饰键重复附加到自身事件，降低 macOS、Linux 被控端忽略快捷键或产生按键残留的风险。
column2: Modifiers no longer duplicate themselves in events, reducing ignored shortcuts and stuck keys on macOS/Linux.

column1: 断开连接、切换页面或失去输入焦点时释放已按下的修饰键，避免下一次输入受到旧按键状态影响。
column2: Releases modifiers on disconnect, page changes or focus loss.

column1: 直连安全握手失败时自动保持加密并改走中继；注册服务器无响应和中继超时会进行有限次数的全新连接重试。
column2: Secure direct failures retry via encrypted relay; ID/relay timeouts use bounded fresh retries.

column1: 1.1.0（1001005）· Linux 外接键盘映射修复
修复 HarmonyOS 6 平板使用蓝牙或 USB 外接键盘控制 Ubuntu/KDE 时，Q、W 等按键错误变成数字键的问题。
column2: Fixed Q/W and other keys becoming digits on Ubuntu/KDE with external HarmonyOS 6 tablet keyboards.

column1: 物理键盘改用通用 USB HID 位置码传递，再根据被控端系统转换为 Windows、Linux、macOS 或 Android 对应键码。
column2: Physical keys use USB HID positions converted for the remote OS.

column1: Linux 被控端使用正确的 Xorg/XKB 键码，Windows 原有扫描码行为保持不变。
column2: Linux uses correct Xorg/XKB codes; Windows scan codes unchanged.

column1: 同步覆盖数字、标点、Shift 大小写、按键释放和会话重置，降低跨平台键位偏移与按键残留风险。
column2: Covers digits, punctuation, Shift case, releases and session reset to reduce cross-platform mapping errors and stuck keys.

column1: 1.1.0（1001004）· 键盘特殊符号输入修复
修复 HarmonyOS PC 使用物理键盘时，Shift 配合数字行无法输入 ! @ # $ % ^ & * ( ) 的问题。
column2: Fixed Shift+number-row symbols on HarmonyOS PC physical keyboards.

column1: 普通数字、Shift 大小写及中文输入保持原有行为，不受本次修复影响。
column2: Regular digits, Shift case and Chinese input remain unchanged.

column1: Ctrl、Alt 或 Win 配合 Shift 与数字键的快捷键继续按物理按键传递，避免破坏远端快捷操作。
column2: Ctrl/Alt/Win with Shift and digits remain physical shortcuts.

column1: 完善数字行长按重复、按键释放和会话重置处理，降低 Shift 或数字键状态残留的风险。
column2: Improved number-row repeats, releases and session resets to prevent stuck Shift/digits.

column1: 自建服务器密钥无效、格式错误或与服务器身份不匹配时，不再只显示笼统的安全握手失败。
column2: Invalid/malformed/mismatched custom server keys now have specific errors.

column1: 新增明确的风险提示，可取消连接，或由用户主动选择“仅本次继续”并临时使用未加密连接。
column2: Added explicit risk prompt to cancel or choose unencrypted continuation for this attempt only.

column1: 降级授权只对当前一次连接有效，不写入设置；断开连接或重新发起普通连接后自动恢复安全校验。
column2: Fallback permission applies only once and is not saved; normal security checks resume on new connections.

column1: 文件传输会话只在当前远控会话已获用户授权时沿用临时降级状态，避免重复失败或永久降低安全性。
column2: File sessions inherit temporary fallback only from an authorized current session, without permanently lowering security.

column1: 补充服务器密钥异常、用户选择及临时降级流程的诊断记录和自动回归检查。
column2: Added key-warning, user-choice and fallback diagnostics and regressions.

column1: 1.1.0（1001002）· 手势、PC组合键与网络连接修复
修复双指、三指滚动后因手指分批抬起误触右键的问题，保留双指轻点右键，取消手势不再触发点击。
column2: Fixed unintended right clicks after staggered multi-finger release; two-finger taps retained, cancelled gestures do not click.

column1: 键盘和鼠标采用统一事件队列，修复 Ctrl/Shift 配合鼠标多选的事件顺序问题，分别跟踪左右修饰键。
column2: Unified input queue fixes modifier/mouse selection ordering and tracks left/right modifiers separately.

column1: 修复 Shift 先松开时字母按键释放不匹配的问题，保留普通字母的远端输入法路径；输入队列异常时释放已按住的按键和鼠标。
column2: Fixed release mismatches when Shift releases first; retains remote IME paths and releases held inputs on queue errors.

column1: 新增 IPv4/IPv6 地址直连及指定端口支持，远控和文件会话均可绕过 ID 服务器；未加密连接显示明确提醒。
column2: Added direct IPv4/IPv6 and custom ports for control/files without an ID server; unencrypted connections clearly warned.

column1: 修正公共服务器默认地址与公钥配置，不覆盖用户的自建服务器设置；远控密码不用于服务器访问令牌。
column2: Corrected public server defaults and keys without overwriting custom settings; remote passwords are not server access tokens.

column1: 完善连接总超时、取消和快速重连，限制文件会话建立与在线状态查询的等待时间，防止旧任务继续运行。
column2: Added bounded setup/availability waits, total connection timeout and cancellation to stop stale tasks during fast reconnects.

column1: 修复在线状态查询长时间黄灯、迟到结果被丢弃等问题；IP直连地址显示独立的状态未知提示，不误报在线或离线。
column2: Fixed persistent unknown status and discarded late results; direct IP entries show unknown instead of falsely online/offline.

column1: 后台视频子模式被系统拒绝后，依次尝试普通多设备互联和兼容接口，补齐任务取消、暂停、恢复和失败重试处理。
column2: Background video falls back to normal multi-device/compatible APIs with cancellation, pause, resume and retry handling.

column1: 已保存连接支持按 ID、名称、在线状态排序并记住选择；诊断日志补充手势判定、键鼠顺序、连接阶段与构建标识。
column2: Saved connections remember ID/name/status sorting; added gesture, input ordering, connection phase and build diagnostics.

column1: 包含上一轮首帧、解码恢复及双栈 Wi-Fi 中继回退优化，详情见下方 1001001 修复记录。
column2: Includes earlier first-frame, decoder recovery and dual-stack Wi-Fi relay improvements; see 1001001 below.

column1: 1.1.0（1001001）· 在线状态与连接稳定性
修复多指滚动、缩放和三指手势结束后误触右键的问题；保留双指轻点右键，取消手势不再触发点击。
column2: Fixed unintended right clicks after multi-finger gestures; two-finger taps retained, cancellation does not click.

column1: 修复鸿蒙 PC 键鼠事件顺序与组合键状态同步，分别跟踪左右 Ctrl/Shift，改善组合键配合鼠标多选。
column2: Fixed PC input ordering/modifier synchronization with separate left/right Ctrl/Shift tracking.

column1: 已保存连接支持按 ID、名称或在线状态排序，并记住选择。
column2: Saved connections remember sorting by ID, name or availability.

column1: 新增 IPv4/IPv6 地址直接连接，支持指定端口，不再依赖 ID 服务器；直连地址显示独立的状态未知提示。
column2: Added direct IPv4/IPv6 and custom ports without ID-server dependency; direct addresses show unknown status.

column1: 修正公共连接服务器默认地址，保留自建配置；连接取消、文件会话建立和在线查询均有独立时限。
column2: Corrected public defaults while retaining custom settings; cancellation, file setup and availability have separate deadlines.

column1: 修复在线状态查询超时后丢弃迟到结果的问题，避免已在线设备持续显示黄色，并补充状态查询耗时与结果诊断。
column2: Accepts late availability results to avoid persistent yellow status and adds timing/result diagnostics.

column1: 取消连接时及时停止旧连接的网络等待，增加连接总时限，减少快速重连时旧任务继续运行的问题。
column2: Cancellation stops old network waits; total deadlines reduce stale reconnect tasks.

column1: 优化双栈网络下 IPv4/IPv6 地址尝试，限制 DNS 与直连等待时间，改善部分 Wi-Fi 和自建服务器的中继回退。
column2: Improved dual-stack attempts with bounded DNS/direct waits for Wi-Fi/custom relay fallback.

column1: 增加连接后无首帧的分阶段恢复：请求刷新画面、尝试 VP9 协商，并在持续无画面时显示明确提示。
column2: Added staged missing-first-frame recovery: refresh, VP9 negotiation and clear no-video warnings.

column1: 修复解码健康检查在没有画面时不执行的问题，补充后台视频暂停期间的保护。
column2: Decoder health checks now run without video and respect background video pauses.

column1: 视频统计按连接重置，分别记录收到数据、解码输出和成功提交画面，修复黑屏被误判为已有画面的问题。
column2: Per-session statistics separate received data, decoded output and submitted frames to avoid falsely detecting video.

column1: 直连后登录或首帧长时间无响应时自动尝试一次中继连接；主动取消或等待二次验证时不会自动重试。
column2: Direct login/first-frame stalls retry once via relay; cancellation and verification waits do not auto-retry.

column1: 增加解码器重启恢复；横竖屏切换时保留软解码参考帧，减少切换后黑屏。
column2: Added decoder restart recovery and preserves software reference frames across rotation.

column1: 导出日志补充应用版本、原生构建标识和连接阶段耗时；签名校验失败时拒绝连接，未加密连接新增提醒。
column2: Logs include version/native build/phase timing; signature failures reject connections and unencrypted sessions show warnings.

column1: 修复后台任务模式与子模式兼容性问题，增加能力探测与多设备互联回退，并补齐音频和文件传输的子模式参数。
column2: Improved background mode compatibility, capability detection, multi-device fallback and audio/transfer parameters.

column1: 1.1.0（1001000）· 连接管理、安卓控制与多屏鼠标
column2: 1.1.0 (1001000) · Connections, Android controls and multi-display cursors

column1: 新建连接区域支持展开和折叠；已保存连接改为一键直连，并将移动、修改和删除统一收纳到“更多”菜单。
column2: Connection form collapses; saved devices connect directly with move/edit/delete under More.

column1: 新增已保存连接的导入与导出：普通备份不包含密码，加密备份可包含密码，并支持合并或覆盖导入。
column2: Added plain/encrypted connection backups with optional passwords and merge/replace import.

column1: 增强自建服务器中继连接兼容性，中继失败时使用新的连接和会话标识自动重试。
column2: Improved custom relay compatibility with fresh connection/session retry on relay failure.

column1: 连接安卓被控端时新增返回、主页、最近任务、音量和电源等系统操作。
column2: Added Android Back, Home, Recents, volume and power actions.

column1: 安卓被控端的手机操作改为底部悬浮条，支持拖动和位置记忆，并取消遮挡远端画面的全屏遮罩。
column2: Android controls use a draggable bottom bar with remembered position and no full-screen blocking overlay.

column1: 修复多显示器切换后鼠标状态残留，以及部分屏幕错误声明已嵌入鼠标而导致远端鼠标不显示的问题。
column2: Fixed stale cursor state and incorrect embedded-cursor declarations after display changes.

column1: 修复鼠标模式按住拖动时，本地预测鼠标与远端真实鼠标同时出现并逐渐岔开的问题。
column2: Fixed local predicted and remote cursors appearing together and diverging during dragging.

column1: 拖动开始时保留短暂的本地预测以维持跟手感，随后自动切换到远端真实鼠标坐标进行校正。
column2: Uses brief local prediction at drag start, then remote coordinates for correction.

column1: 保留双击按住框选、左键拖动和“左键按住”状态提示，不影响远端文件框选操作。
column2: Retains double-tap hold selection, left-button dragging and held-button hints.

column1: 优化手机鼠标模式的双击按住拖动，扩大识别时间和触点容错范围，降低框选手势识别失败的概率。
column2: Improved double-tap hold dragging with larger timing/touch tolerances.

column1: 修复远端文件管理器无法拉出文件选框的问题，框选时使用干净的“左键按下、移动、抬起”事件序列。
column2: Fixed box selection with clean left-button down/move/up sequences.

column1: 触摸拖拽期间不再因输入焦点短暂切换提前释放左键，并在异常释放后自动恢复左键按下状态。
column2: Dragging survives brief focus changes and restores left-button state after unexpected release.

column1: 拖拽生效时新增蓝色“左键按住”提示，并补充双击、拖拽和左键恢复诊断日志。
column2: Added a blue held-button hint and double-tap/drag/recovery diagnostics.

column1: 1.0.9（1000904）· 连接状态、文件取回、输入与视频
已保存连接新增在线状态灯，并修复状态查询端口错误导致设备可以连接却一直显示黄色的问题；绿色表示在线，灰色表示离线。
column2: Added availability dots and fixed query port errors; green is online and gray offline.

column1: 修复远端文件已经传输完成，但保存到手机后变成 0 字节或提示保存失败的问题。
column2: Fixed completed downloads becoming zero-byte files or showing save failures.

column1: 重新设计远端文件选择界面，补充文件类型、大小、修改时间和更完整的文件名显示。
column2: Redesigned file picker with type, size, date and more complete names.

column1: 文件传输进度新增实时速度、已传输大小和批量任务数量，并支持随时取消；取消取回时会清理未完成文件。
column2: Transfer progress includes speed, bytes and batch counts with cancellation and incomplete-download cleanup.

column1: 修复 Shift 配合字母输入失效的问题，同时避免中文输入法被错误切换为直接输入英文字母。
column2: Fixed Shift letters while preserving Chinese IME input.

column1: 优化放大画面后的拖动和边缘跟随，扩大有效平移范围并提升物理鼠标靠边移动的响应速度。
column2: Improved zoomed panning range and physical mouse edge tracking.

column1: 视频编码改为自动协商：双方支持且远端具备编码能力时可优先使用 H.265，同时保留 VP9 黑屏恢复方案。
column2: Automatically negotiates codecs, preferring supported H.265 while retaining VP9 recovery.

column1: 新增从远端取回文件，支持单文件、多选批量取回以及整个文件夹递归下载。
column2: Added single/batch and recursive folder downloads.

column1: 批量或文件夹取回完成后在本机压缩为一个 ZIP，保留目录层级并只需选择一次保存位置。
column2: Batch/folder downloads create one local ZIP preserving structure with a single save destination.

column1: 修复批量文件实际保存成功却提示失败的问题，并补充取回、压缩和保存阶段的诊断记录。
column2: Fixed false batch save failures and added download/archive/save diagnostics.

column1: 修复 HarmonyOS PC 使用 Ctrl、Shift 和 CapsLock 配合鼠标或键盘时，组合操作未正确传递到远端的问题。
column2: Fixed PC Ctrl/Shift/CapsLock with mouse and keyboard operations.

column1: 新增远控会话后台保持：锁屏或切换到其他应用后继续维持连接，解锁返回时自动恢复视频画面。
column2: Added background session retention across locking/app switching, with video restored on return.

column1: 设置中新增诊断日志开关，默认关闭；仅在用户主动开启后记录连接和解码信息。
column2: Added opt-in diagnostic logging, off by default.

column1: 修复边缘跟随开启后按钮选中状态不刷新的问题，并统一所有选中按钮为主蓝色。
column2: Fixed stale auto-pan selection and unified selected colors.

column1: 移动画面模式的单指平移速度提高 50%，改善手机和平板上的画面拖动效率。
column2: One-finger panning speed increased by 50% on phones/tablets.

column1: 修复 HarmonyOS PC 使用物理鼠标或触控板时，远端左键偶发无响应的问题。
column2: Fixed intermittent left-click failures on PC mice/touchpads.

column1: 修复关闭本地鼠标后，指针进入状态栏、工具栏、按钮或弹窗仍保持隐藏的问题。
column2: Local pointers reappear over app controls when hidden in remote video.

column1: 隐藏本地指针时继续显示并同步远端真实鼠标，改善缩放和平移后的操作一致性。
column2: Retains synchronized remote cursors when hiding local pointers.

column1: 1000816 · 边缘跟随与输入
新增放大画面后的边缘自动平移，鼠标在边缘短暂停留后视野会平滑跟随。
column2: Added smooth zoomed edge panning after brief cursor hover.

column1: 加入触发延迟、渐进速度和自动停止保护，降低画面意外移动。
column2: Added delayed triggering, gradual speed and automatic stop protection.

column1: 调整远控工具栏，将“键盘”和“移动画面”按钮位置对调。
column2: Swapped Keyboard and Pan view buttons.

column1: 修复 PC 端物理鼠标或触控板偶发丢失左键抬起，导致后续点击失效的问题。
column2: Fixed lost physical left-button releases breaking later clicks.

column1: 1000815 · 远端鼠标同步
显示远端真实鼠标样式，并修复缩放、平移和多显示器场景下的坐标漂移。
column2: Shows real remote cursor shapes and fixes zoom/pan/multi-display drift.

column1: 分离本机鼠标指针开关与远端鼠标显示，关闭本机指针后远端鼠标仍然可见。
column2: Separates local pointer visibility from remote cursor display.

column1: 修复手机触控移动远端鼠标时，电脑端已经移动但手机端光标停在原位的问题。
column2: Fixed stale phone cursor positions after remote movement.

column1: 新增放大画面后的“移动画面”模式，单指可平移视野且不会误操作远端鼠标。
column2: Added one-finger zoomed panning without remote clicks.

column1: 移动模式选中后按钮显示绿色，并在平移视野时继续显示远端鼠标位置。
column2: Pan selection used green in this version and retained remote cursor display.

column1: 移动画面模式保留双指滚动和捏合缩放，并在全屏提供悬浮入口。
column2: Panning retains two-finger scroll/pinch with a full-screen floating entry.

column1: 1000813 · 连接稳定性与诊断
优化网络延迟探测响应兼容性，降低部分远端主动断开连接的风险。
column2: Improved latency-probe compatibility to reduce remote disconnects.

column1: 增强完整诊断日志，记录协议消息、视频接收、远端关闭原因和连接结束统计。
完善异常连接的日志导出信息，便于继续定位已连接黑屏和断线问题。
column2: Improved exported diagnostics for black screens and disconnects.

column1: 1000812 · 视频解码兼容
新增 VP8、AV1 和 H.265 视频解码支持，扩大对不同远端编码配置的兼容范围。
column2: Added VP8, AV1 and H.265 decoding.

column1: 状态信息新增当前视频编码格式，并标明硬件解码或软件解码。
column2: Status shows the codec and hardware/software decoding.

column1: 完善 VP9 软件解码回退，提升部分旧系统、虚拟机和特殊显卡环境的出画成功率。
column2: Improved VP9 software fallback for older systems, VMs and unusual GPUs.

column1: 1000811 · 黑屏与横屏修复
修复断开后快速重新连接时偶发无响应的问题。
修复部分无显卡直通虚拟机已收到视频流但持续黑屏的问题。
column2: Fixed received-video black screens on some VMs without GPU passthrough.

column1: 完整处理批量视频帧并保留关键帧和时间戳，提升首屏成功率。
column2: Processes batch video frames with keyframes/timestamps for better first-frame delivery.

column1: H264 解码无画面时自动请求关键帧，并支持切换 VP9 恢复画面。
column2: Requests keyframes and supports VP9 recovery when H.264 shows no video.

column1: 修复切换横屏时偶发闪退和部分页面未适配的问题。
column2: Fixed landscape crashes and layout gaps.

column1: 1.0.8 · 界面与输入
移除远控时遮挡画面的本地输入框，只保留系统键盘。
column2: Removed the obstructive local input box, retaining the system keyboard.

column1: 修复物理键盘 Ctrl、Shift、Alt、Meta 和组合键传递。
修复横屏页面内容被底部导航遮挡的问题。
column2: Fixed bottom navigation covering landscape content.

column1: 优化横屏双栏页面，连接列表和编辑区域可以独立上下滚动。
column2: Landscape connection lists and editors scroll independently.

column1: 调整分组箭头、输入框清除按钮和首页蓝色扇形背景。
column2: Refined group arrows, input clear buttons and blue home background.

column1: 优化深色模式可读性以及手机、平板的页面布局。
column2: Improved dark-mode readability and phone/tablet layouts.

column1: 1.0.8 · 连接与管理
已保存连接支持新建分组、重命名、展开折叠和移动连接。
column2: Saved connections support groups, renaming, expansion and moving.

column1: 新增 IPv6 地址连接支持，指定端口时可使用 [IPv6]:端口。
完善中继安全握手与二次验证流程。
column2: Improved secure relay handshake and two-factor flows.

column1: 尝试修复同一 Wi-Fi 下无法控制安卓被控端的问题。
1.0.8 · 远控体验
新增手机、平板和 2in1 横屏及全屏远控，支持自动旋转。
column2: Added landscape/full-screen remote control and automatic rotation.

column1: 全屏三指上滑可调出系统键盘，输入直接传递到远端。
column2: Three-finger swipe up in full screen opens the keyboard for remote typing.

column1: 完善鼠标和触摸模式，支持拖动、右键、滚动与双指缩放。
column2: Improved mouse/touch dragging, right click, scrolling and pinch zoom.

column1: 同步远端真实鼠标位置，并在远端已显示光标时自动隐藏本地指针。
column2: Synchronizes remote cursors and avoids duplicate local overlays.

column1: 动态范围
修复 API 地址簿中的 IPv4、IPv6 及带端口设备被过滤的问题，支持导入与双向同步，并保留本地密码、分组及连接设置。
column2: Fixed filtering of IPv4, IPv6 and IP-with-port devices in API address books. These devices now support import and two-way sync while preserving local passwords, groups and connection settings.

column1: 加强地址簿同步保护：遇到重复分页、数量不一致或不完整列表时停止同步，避免误删本地连接；仍可浏览非标准服务器返回的有效设备。
column2: Address-book sync now stops on repeated pages, inconsistent counts or incomplete lists to prevent accidental deletion of local connections. Valid devices from non-standard servers remain available for browsing.

column1: 修复地址簿“全选”后选中状态可能反复切换的问题，避免重复触发勾选回调。
column2: Fixed repeated selection changes after Select all in address books by avoiding duplicate checkbox callbacks.

column1: 输出不支持
优化 PC 切换本机应用后的画面和输入恢复：异步处理视频解码回调和收帧任务，减少重入阻塞；通过心跳识别失效连接，不把静止画面误判为断线。
column2: Improved video and input recovery when returning from another PC app. Asynchronous decoding callbacks and frame tasks reduce reentrant blocking; heartbeat-based health checks do not mistake a static screen for a lost connection.

column1: 新增系统画中画入口，复用远端视频画面，支持小窗观看与恢复主窗口；小窗不包含远控操作层，控制时请返回主窗口，设备和系统需支持画中画。
column2: Added system picture-in-picture using the remote video surface. Watch in a small window and restore the main window to control the remote device. Picture-in-picture requires device and system support and does not include remote controls.

column1: 整合远控操作菜单为屏幕、输入、键盘、画面、更多和断开，统一淡蓝色选中状态、圆角样式和展开动画，保留手机、平板与 PC 的布局差异。
column2: Unified remote controls into Displays, Input, Keyboard, View, More and Disconnect, with consistent pale-blue selection, rounded styling and expansion animations. Phone, tablet and PC layouts remain device-specific.

column1: PC 新增适应窗口、原始比例和 25%～300% 自定义缩放，以及按远端比例调整窗口；沉浸与全屏工具栏可固定或自动收起，保留退出入口。
column2: Added Fit window, Original scale and custom 25%–300% scaling on PC, plus window resizing to the remote aspect ratio. Immersive and fullscreen toolbars can be pinned or auto-collapsed while keeping an exit control.

column1: 优化 PC 窗口失焦后的键鼠释放、恢复焦点与系统指针处理；完善真实显示器尺寸读取和视频 Surface 重绑定，避免使用虚构分辨率。
column2: Improved key and mouse release, focus restoration and system cursor handling when PC windows lose focus. Display dimensions and video surface rebinding now use real display data instead of invented resolutions.

column1: 新安装或首次升级至此版本默认开启已保存设备在线状态显示；之后手动关闭会被记住，不会在每次启动或后续升级时强制开启。
column2: Saved-device online status is enabled by default for new installs or the first upgrade to this version. Turning it off is remembered; it is not forcibly enabled on every launch or later upgrade.

column1: 已保存连接的“更多”菜单新增重命名，独立修改名称，不改变连接 ID、密码或分组，并沿用现有云同步机制。
column2: Added Rename to the More menu for saved connections. Only the name changes; connection ID, password and group are preserved, using the existing cloud sync mechanism.

column1: 设置中的语言和按钮样式改为紧凑下拉选择，平时只显示当前选项，菜单中标记已选项；保留立即生效、记忆选择及大字体适配。
column2: Language and button style settings now use compact dropdowns showing only the current choice. Menus mark the selected option and retain immediate application, saved preferences and large-font support.

column1: 1.2.20（1002020）· 多语言、折叠屏与 HDR 视频适配
column2: 1.2.20 (1002020) · Languages, foldable screens and HDR video

column1: 新增简体中文、繁体中文和英语，默认跟随系统；可在设置中手动切换，保存语言偏好，不影响远控连接、按键和用户文件名。
column2: Added Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and English with system language as the default. Manual language preferences are saved without changing remote connections, keys or user filenames.

column1: 优化折叠屏内外屏及横竖屏的软键盘避让：保留远端画面当前比例，按可见区域和最后鼠标位置上移画面，光标同步移动；折叠、展开和旋转后重新计算。
column2: Improved keyboard avoidance on inner and outer foldable screens in both orientations. The remote view keeps its scale and shifts with the cursor based on the visible area and last pointer position; layout is recalculated after folding, unfolding or rotation.

column1: 新增实验性 HDR 视频接收与显示适配，识别 HDR10/PQ 和 HLG；连接信息增加动态范围与输出路径，补充色彩、位深和显示设备的脱敏诊断。
column2: Added experimental HDR reception and display handling for HDR10/PQ and HLG. Connection information now shows dynamic range and output path, with redacted color, bit-depth and display diagnostics.

column1: AV1 软件解码增加 HDR 转 SDR，完善 VP9/AV1 高位深画面转换及解码切换的色彩状态清理。真正 HDR 显示需要远端发送 HDR 视频及设备支持，不能恢复已转换为 SDR 的画面，实际效果仍需真机验证。
column2: Added HDR-to-SDR conversion for software AV1, improved high-bit-depth VP9/AV1 conversion and color-state cleanup when switching decoders. True HDR requires an HDR stream from the remote device and a supported display; SDR-converted video cannot be restored to HDR. Real-device validation is still required.
1.2.22 (1002022) · Revision r1: menus and theme persistence

column1: 远控功能栏统一采用蓝灰色图标和淡蓝选中效果，深色模式同步调整图标颜色；保留原有菜单功能与自定义排序。
column2: Remote controls use consistent blue-gray icons and pale-blue selection, with dark-mode icon colors; existing actions and custom ordering are preserved.

column1: 二级菜单更加紧凑：屏幕选择横向排列，画面和更多按文字宽度贴合；大字体、不同语言和窗口缩放自动适配，PC 比例滑块保留操作空间。
column2: Compact submenus use a horizontal display selector and content-fitting View and More menus, adapting to large fonts, languages and window sizes while preserving PC scale-slider space.

column1: 输入菜单改为鼠标与触摸双选，图标和文字居中，窄屏或大字体自动上下排列；视觉尺寸缩小，点击区域不缩小。
column2: The Input menu has centered Mouse and Touch choices, stacked on narrow windows or large fonts; smaller visuals retain the original touch targets.

column1: 修正隐藏的边缘跟随占位导致的上下留白；菜单顶部对齐，展开和收回统一淡入淡出与轻微缩放，收回完成前避免误触远端。
column2: Removed blank space reserved for hidden auto-pan actions; menus align at the top and use matching fade/scale animations, preventing remote input leakage during dismissal.

column1: 修复深色模式重启后不保持：独立保存主题选择，启动先恢复，手动深色或浅色不被系统覆盖；补充保存失败提示与脱敏诊断。旧版本未成功保存的选择需重新设置一次。
column2: Theme choices are saved independently and restored at startup without overriding explicit dark/light choices; save failures and safe diagnostics are included. Choices never saved by older versions must be selected once again.

column1: 1.2.23（1002023）· 独立远控偏好与悬浮功能栏
按服务器地址与远端 ID 独立记住鼠标或触摸模式、光标显示、虚拟鼠标、边缘跟随及键鼠兼容选择；不同远端互不覆盖，未单独修改的项目沿用旧默认值。
column2: Mouse or touch mode, cursor display, virtual mouse, edge following and input compatibility are remembered separately for each server and remote ID. Remote devices do not overwrite each other; unchanged options inherit legacy defaults.

column1: 按远端记住“控”和“键”的位置、排序、收放及更多按键顺序，保存 PC 固定状态、画面模式和缩放比例；不保存按键按住、输入内容、全屏及当前菜单等临时状态。
column2: Control and key toolbar positions, ordering, expansion and additional key order are remembered per remote device, along with PC pinning, view mode and zoom. Held keys, input content, fullscreen and open menus are not saved.

column1: 统一悬浮功能栏：手机和平板横竖屏均在底部横向排列，PC 普通窗口和全屏均在顶部居中；大小窗口都可收为“控”，保留固定或自动收起及独立退出全屏入口。
column2: Floating controls are horizontal at the bottom on phones and tablets in either orientation, and top-centered in normal and fullscreen PC windows. All window sizes support collapse, pinning or auto-collapse, with a separate fullscreen exit.

column1: 功能栏拖动位置按可用区域比例保存，窗口缩放、折叠、旋转和键盘弹出后重新限制在可见区域；二级菜单跟随按钮位置展开。
column2: Dragged toolbar positions are saved relative to the available area and kept visible after window resizing, folding, rotation or keyboard display. Submenus follow their button positions.

column1: 键盘旁的展开箭头改为同系列矢量图标，与键盘按钮共用淡蓝选中背景和细分隔线，展开收起增加旋转动画；点击箭头不会自动弹出软键盘。
column2: The keyboard expansion arrow now uses a matching vector icon, shared pale-blue selection and a thin divider, with a rotation animation. Tapping the arrow does not open the software keyboard.

column1: 偏好修改合并写入，拖动或捏合结束后保存，离开远控时刷新待保存数据；补充脱敏恢复与保存诊断，不记录密码或输入内容。
column2: Preference updates are batched, saved after dragging or pinching, and flushed when leaving the remote session. Restore and save diagnostics are redacted and never record passwords or input content.

column1: 修复 IPv6 或较长服务器地址下，独立远控偏好的配置键被截断、重连后无法恢复的问题；不改变网络连接协议。
column2: Fixed truncated per-device preference keys with IPv6 or long server addresses, allowing settings to be restored after reconnecting. Network protocols are unchanged.

column1: 1.2.24（1002024）· Mac 组合键与远控偏好修复
修复远控 Mac 时自动键盘模式混用发送路径的问题：Command、Ctrl、Shift、Option 与实体字母、符号、方向键及功能键统一使用 Mac 键码映射，保留传统兼容模式和中文输入。
column2: Fixed mixed input paths in automatic keyboard mode when controlling a Mac. Command, Ctrl, Shift, Option and physical letters, symbols, navigation and function keys now share Mac keycode mapping. Legacy compatibility and Chinese text input are preserved.

column1: 合并实体键盘、原生事件和状态查询重复上报的修饰键按下，保留左右修饰键独立状态；实体键盘与快捷栏共同按住同一键时，不因其中一个松开而提前释放。
column2: Coalesced duplicate modifier presses from physical keys, native events and state polling while preserving left and right keys. A modifier held by both a physical key and the shortcut bar is released only after both owners let go.

column1: 优化失去焦点、切换键盘模式及离开远控时的按键释放，按实际已发送状态补齐松键事件，减少远端 Ctrl、Shift 或 Command 状态残留。
column2: Improved key release on focus loss, keyboard mode changes and session exit. Release events follow the actual sent-key state to reduce stuck Ctrl, Shift or Command modifiers on the remote device.

column1: 修复首次连接时未创建远端 ID 存储项、导致独立操控偏好无法保存的问题；按服务器与远端分别恢复设置，不改变现有密码保护、连接协议和画质配置。
column2: Fixed missing remote-ID storage on the first connection that prevented per-device preferences from being saved. Settings are restored per server and remote device without changing password protection, network protocols or video quality settings.

删除后，该分组里的连接将移到“未分组”，连接和保存的密码不会删除。
column2: Connections in this group will move to Ungrouped. Connections and saved passwords will not be deleted.

column1: 分组已删除
分组菜单新增删除与二次确认；分组内的全部连接移到“未分组”，保留连接、保存的密码及独立操控设置。
column2: Added group deletion with confirmation. All connections in the group move to Ungrouped, preserving connections, saved passwords and per-device control preferences.

column1: 支持删除空分组，保留系统“未分组”；保存失败会明确提示，避免误报成功，支持安全重试，不影响其他分组和正在编辑的连接内容。
column2: Empty groups can also be deleted, while the built-in Ungrouped section is protected. Save failures are reported clearly and can be retried safely without affecting other groups or the connection being edited.

column1: 所有分组继续共用 ID、名称、在线状态及升降序排序，补充分组内排序一致性回归；不增加独立分组排序或改变现有排序规则。
column2: All groups continue to share ID, name and online-status sorting with ascending or descending order. Added regression coverage for consistent in-group sorting; no separate group sorting or changes to existing rules.

column1: 连接显示方式
精简列表
现有布局
保存显示方式失败，请重试
column2: Failed to save the view preference; please retry

column1: 已保存连接新增“现有布局”和“精简列表”切换，入口位于标题右侧；精简模式收掉大头像及多余留白，保留在线状态、名称、ID、连接和更多菜单。
column2: Added Standard layout and Compact list views for saved connections, selectable beside the heading. Compact view removes large avatars and extra spacing while keeping online status, names, IDs, Connect and More.

column1: 手机采用紧凑双行，平板和 PC 宽屏采用单行对齐；按实际可用宽度、窗口缩放、横竖屏及字体大小调整，大字体或窄窗口下操作按钮自动换行。
column2: Phones use compact two-line entries, while wide tablet and PC windows align entries in a single row. Layout adapts to available width, window resizing, orientation and font size, with actions moving to a separate line for large fonts or narrow windows.

column1: 在本机记住显示方式，默认保留现有布局，所有分组共用同一视图；切换不改变连接、密码、分组、排序、搜索、编辑内容或云同步数据。
column2: The view preference is remembered locally, defaults to Standard layout and is shared by all groups. Switching views does not alter connections, passwords, groups, sorting, search, editor drafts or cloud-sync data.

column1: 优化列表标题的大字体换行及英文连接按钮宽度，保持深浅色和按钮样式一致；保存显示方式失败时明确提示，补充不含账号密码的诊断记录。
column2: Improved heading wrapping for large fonts and the width of the English Connect button, preserving light/dark themes and button styles. View-save failures are reported clearly, with diagnostics that contain no account credentials.
